remarks: acious 2-Bedroom Apartment - Bright, Updated & Ideally Located  Welcome to this generously sized 2-bedroom apartment offering over 1,000 square feet of comfortable living space. This well-maintained unit combines space, functionality, and convenience-perfect for those seeking a quality rental in a desirable area. There is a walk up attic that is not part of the rental. Landlord is planning on adding two more bedrooms in the near future.  The apartment features a large living room with abundant natural light, an updated eat in kitchen with ample cabinet and counter space. Both bedrooms are well-proportioned with excellent closet storage.  Additional highlights include:  Updated kitchen and bath Hardwood floors throughout Ample closet space Bright and airy layout Quiet, well-kept property  Conveniently located near shopping, restaurants, and major transportation routes, making commuting and daily errands easy.  Available for immediate occupancy. Serious inquiries only.
